notes: California sweep. Tenth Inning Productions (East Bay Card Show, LA Card Expo, San Diego Card Expo, TCG NOW) and The Showcase Card Show have organizer calendars with 2026 and 2027 dates, and make up most of the records. Vendor terms are shared: Tenth Inning's vendor form covers five locations (LA, San Diego, Palm Springs, SF Bay Area) with 6 ft tables and no prices published, so vendor.application_url is the same on every Tenth Inning record. Tenth Inning and Showcase event pages show prices in dollars with no currency label; recorded as USD because every venue is in California. Skipped per brief: Maximum Card Show (including its Bay Area Nov 21 2026 listing), Front Row, USA Card Show, Collect-A-Con LA and Maximum San Diego. The TCG NOW Woodland Hills Nov 1 2026 listing looks like the same event as LA Card Expo Oct 31 to Nov 1 at Warner Center Marriott, so it is not recorded separately. Past California shows without a stated size were not recorded: East Bay Card Show July 25 to 26 2026 at Santa Clara County Fairgrounds (tickets link to Tenth Inning), Fresno Card and Collectible Show Aug 22 to 23 2026 (venue page, no size), Sacramento Card Show Aug 7 and Sep 18 to 20, The Grind in Elk Grove Sep 5, Folsom and Cameron Park Super Show Aug 29, Sacramento Sports Card and Autograph Expo Roseville Sep 5 to 6, Regional SoCal Cards and Collectibles in Garden Grove Sep 13 (TCG only), Auburn Grass Valley Expo Oct 17, Bakersfield Fall Collectors Expo Oct 10 to 11, Monster Collectibles Sacramento Oct 9, Hype Con Bay Area June 28, San Francisco Card Show Marriott Marquis Aug 28 to 30, Collectors 1st Night Redwood City Sep 11. StocktonCon Winter (Mar 1 2026) is a general collectibles and art convention with no card vendor detail, so skipped. Four guessed domains did not resolve or were parked, so no organizer pages were found for the listing-only leads. All 8 WebSearch used; 38 WebFetch used, including the failed guesses and three rate limited attempts.
